The corporate website is ceasing to be a storefront.

If comparisons are increasingly being made by an AI agent, what matters is not presentation, but what it can verify: identity, origin, accountability, a single source of truth.

The question is no longer "How do you persuade"? The question is: "What about you is verifiable"?
